_comment: Single source for SDS Manager EHS product pages (platform page plus seven modules, synced 2026-10-06; Compliance Reporting, Document Control and Assets & Maintenance are listed on the platform page without their own URLs, so they are not here) used as internal-link and CTA candidates. Consumed by the model (to pick link/CTA targets during drafting) and scripts/link_check.py (to identify product links and enforce the deepest-page-wins rule). The selection rule, anchor rules, and prohibited-target rules stay in voice-and-style.md; only this enumerated page table lives here. Chemical/SDS-focused topics keep the existing sdsmanager.com/us/ and product sub-pages; this registry adds the EHS suite alongside them, it does not replace them.
region_slug_note: URLs shown for /us/. Swap the region slug (/uk/, /ca/, /au/, /nz/) per REGION.
display_name_note: In blog/article copy, refer to the EHS platform by its canonical name 'EHS Solution by SDS Manager'. Live product pages may render it 'SDS Manager EHS'; blog copy uses 'EHS Solution by SDS Manager'. Keep it distinct from the separate 'SDS Manager' SDS/chemical-management product it integrates with.
selection_rule: Deepest relevant page wins: link the module page when the article sits squarely in one module's territory; link the landing page only when the topic is platform-level or spans multiple modules. Do not link both the landing page and a module page for the same purpose in one article.

pages.name: EHS platform (landing)
pages.covers: EHS software generally, safety management systems, digitizing safety programs, or topics spanning 2+ modules below

pages.name: Incident Management
pages.covers: Incident/near-miss/hazard reporting, incident investigation, root-cause analysis, CAPA from incidents, reporting participation/anonymous reporting, incident trends and dashboards

pages.name: Risk Management
pages.covers: Hazard identification, risk assessment/matrices, inherent vs. residual risk, heat maps, control libraries and hierarchies of control, JHA/JSA-adjacent topics

pages.name: Audit & Inspection
pages.covers: Safety audits, inspections and checklists, audit scheduling/programs, photo evidence, findings-to-CAPA workflows, ISO 45001/ISO 14001/OSHA audit readiness

pages.name: Incident Investigation
pages.covers: Guided incident investigations (5 Whys, fishbone, decision tree), evidence handling, root-cause analysis

pages.name: CAPA Management
pages.covers: Corrective and preventive actions with owners, due dates and independent sign-off, linked back to the finding that raised them

pages.name: Safety Training
pages.covers: Training assignment by role and site, certification expiry surfaced before it lapses, getting procedures and safe-work knowledge to the people who do the work

pages.name: Contractor Management
pages.covers: Contractor approval before work starts, documents that carry expiry dates, one register of every contractor company
